title: Machine Learning Models for the Prediction of Postpartum Depression: Application and Comparison Based on a Cohort Study.
summary: A cohort of 508 pregnant women was used to compare random-forest and SVM postpartum-depression models; the best FFS-RF SVM reached sensitivity 0.69 and AUC 0.78, with feature-importance analysis and cross-validation.
ai_technology: Random-forest feature selection and RF/SVM models predict postpartum depression outcomes in a pregnancy cohort.
organization: XiangYa School of Public Health, Central South University, Changsha, China

evidence.tested: A cohort of 508 pregnant women was used to compare random-forest and SVM postpartum-depression models; the best FFS-RF SVM reached sensitivity 0.69 and AUC 0.78, with feature-importance analysis and cross-validation.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
